summary: The research deliverable fits the latest outcome: a first-party vendor capability matrix plus a file/symbol-based gap analysis of actual Electron implementation, followed by recommendations without changing product scope or code. One evidence-provenance correction is required: distinguish the explicitly selected Electron runtime from the pending approval/review status of the amended PRD/UX set, and fix the ADR path. No new user approval is needed to conduct this research.

open_findings.title: Do not promote the amended PRD/UX set to approved research authority
open_findings.description: The plan calls PRD v0.6 user-approved and cites docs/decisions/0002-electron-runtime.md, which does not exist. Contract DR-1 repeats approved PRD v0.6. The current PRD and UX headers say review required, the UX explicitly calls the Electron amendment pending independent review, and spec-index v0.12 says prior approval covers old document hashes. The real ADR is docs/decisions/0002-desktop-runtime.md and confirms the Electron choice while explicitly separating implementation-input approval. Treating these statuses as equivalent risks carrying a false approval claim into the report and next-slice handoff.
open_findings.requested_change: Correct the plan and DR-1 to distinguish preserved approved feature scope, the user-selected Electron/macOS/Windows/app-owned-sidecar target, and current PRD/UX amendments as research comparison context with their stated pending review/approval status. Use docs/decisions/0002-desktop-runtime.md. If a newer exact-version approval receipt exists, cite that concrete receipt instead. Re-register and re-review only these changed concerns; do not request new approval or block independent evidence collection.
open_findings.validation_basis: Read-only comparison of plan R1 and contract DR-1 against docs/product/prd.md header, docs/design/specs/workbench-ux.md header, docs/engineering/spec-index.md, and the accepted ADR-0002.

review_notes: The four research groups cover the requested outcome. In the final matrix, explicitly enumerate import/create/remove-from-list/physical-delete, artifact formats, and registration/inventory/connection state; do not let a generic lifecycle or configuration cell hide requested behaviors.
Keep Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and vendor app/CLI surfaces attributable within family rows so documentation about one surface does not establish another surface feature.

The registered section/link-count check is a structural smoke check only. Citation entailment, complete matrix coverage, status classification and actionable implementation gaps must be established by coordinator source verification and the planned independent analysis review.

The static repository audit may establish implemented code paths and integration gaps, not successful Electron execution, macOS/Windows packaging or process/security enforcement. No runtime tests or browser benchmark are required for this bounded research deliverable.
review_boundary: Independent plan review only. No vendor research, application source audit, runtime tests or product edits were performed. The formal review file is the only artifact written.
